223803.title: Security Misconfiguration Scan on https://callingagent-production-7097.up.railway.app/
223803.content:
- Open directories: None detected on root or API paths.
- Exposed sensitive files: None detected (no .env, .git/config, sitemap.xml).
- HTTP security headers:
  - Strict-Transport-Security: Present (max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains)
  - X-Content-Type-Options: Present (nosniff)
  - X-Frame-Options: Absent
  - Content-Security-Policy: Absent
  - Referrer-Policy: Absent
  - Permissions-Policy: Absent
- Server fingerprint: Server header is missing or minimal on main and API endpoints.

Recommendations:
- Add missing security headers like X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy to harden the security posture.
- Verify server configuration to ensure consistent informative headers without revealing unnecessary info.

No signs of dangerous open access or misconfigured public files found based on this rapid scan.
